title: Visiting Professor of Law
bio: Ayelet Shachar (LL.M., J.S.D., Yale Law School) is the Irving G. and Eleanor D. Tragen Chair in Comparative Law, University of California, Berkeley. Trained in law and political theory, Shachar’s areas of interest include American and comparative immigration law and policy, citizenship theory, borders and human rights, international and transnational law, jurisprudence and legal theory, […]
